授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
自然科学の基礎となる考え方を，じっくりとグループ学習中心に学んでいきます．前提とする知識は数IIBと「共創の数学」で学習した内容（pythonの知識は不要）です．「共創の数学」で扱った微分積分の復習をしつつ，インタラクティブな授業を行いますので，気軽にご参加ください．教室は5401または5411で行います．受講しようか迷っている学生は，まず以下よりMoodleに登録して
https://moodle.s.kyushu-u.ac.jp/course/view.php?id=70010
「受講を考えている学生へ：この授業について，To Students Considering Taking This Class: About This Course」という部分をご覧ください．
We will study the foundations of natural sciences through group work. The prerequisite knowledge includes the content learned in Math IIB and "Math for ISI" (no Python knowledge required). While reviewing the calculus covered in "Math for ISI," we will conduct interactive classes, so feel free to join. Classes will be held in rooms 5401 or 5411. Students who are about to take this course should first register on Moodle from the link below and find "To Students Considering Taking This Class: About This Course" on the page.
https://moodle.s.kyushu-u.ac.jp/course/view.php?id=70010
基本的には授業は英語で行われます．学生の質問や振り返りの課題，日本人のみのグループおける活動では日本語を用いても構いません．
The classes will basically be conducted in English. However, students may use Japanese for questions, reflection assignments, and discussions in groups consisting only of Japanese students.
Proportion of English:
Language spoken by the lecturer: 80%
Language used for slides during the lecture: 80%
Language spoken by students during their presentations in class: 0%~100%
Language spoken by students during discussion: 0%~100%
Language for written assignments: 50%

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 自然科学の基礎となる考え方（実験と数式に基づく論理体系）を，ルネサンス直後に起きた科学革命に焦点をあてながら学んでいく．特に，数式を用いて自然法則を記述すること，観測事実と照らし合わせて確かめることがなぜ重要なのか理解し，科学と非科学の境目に着目していく．それにより，自然界を俯瞰する目と幅広いものの見方を涵養する．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: We will learn about the fundamental principles of natural science, which are based on experiments and mathematics, by focusing on the scientific revolution that occurred shortly after the Renaissance. In particular, we will study why it is important to use mathematical equations to describe natural laws and to verify them by comparing them with observations. We will also examine the distinction between science and non-science, which will help us develop a comprehensive perspective on observing nature and cultivate a broad way of thinking.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: 数IIBまで学んでいることを前提とします．
